description:
A Windows 11 focused rebuild of GestureSign for touchpad and mouse gestures.

GestureSign V2 is a Windows 11 focused rebuild of the classic open-source GestureSign project. It supports touchpad gestures, touchscreen gestures, mouse gestures, gesture trails, per-app actions, ignore rules, tray controls, Smart Close, Smart New Tab, and bundled Kando radial menu quick actions.
- Added Smart New Tab for browsers, File Explorer, Windows Terminal, VS Code, and the new Notepad.
- Improved two-finger touchscreen recognition on devices that report contacts in separate input frames, including H3C MegaBook.
- Captured the final touch-up coordinate so edge-swipe direction works on devices that report only start and final positions.
- Pausing recognition from the tray now visibly dims and disables inactive settings pages and shows a restore action.
